reason: A browser-side DSH plugin that automatically expands newly arriving top-level tool-call result cards and provides an in-sidebar enable/disable switch, without replacing native renderers or using host behavior.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DSH 浏览器界面的客户端插件，可自动展开新到达的顶层工具调用结果卡片，并通过侧栏开关控制该功能。
summaries.en: A client-side DSH browser plugin that automatically expands newly arrived top-level tool-call result cards and provides a sidebar toggle to control the behavior.

capabilities: Observes newly rendered tool-call cards in the browser interface
Automatically expands top-level collapsed tool-call result rows
Injects a sidebar toggle to enable or disable the behavior
